name: weathercloud-api
description: OpenAPI specification and Cloudflare Forge documentation pipeline for Weathercloud

scripts.lint: npm run lint:openapi && npm run lint:fern
scripts.generate:python: fern generate --group python-sdk --local --force --package && if [ -d sdk-assets/python ]; then cp -rf sdk-assets/python/. sdks/python/; fi
scripts.generate:csharp: fern generate --group csharp-sdk --local --force && if [ -d sdk-assets/csharp ]; then cp -rf sdk-assets/csharp/. sdks/csharp/; fi
scripts.generate:typescript: fern generate --group typescript-sdk --local --force --package && if [ -d sdk-assets/typescript ]; then cp -rf sdk-assets/typescript/. sdks/typescript/; fi
scripts.generate:go: fern generate --group go-sdk --local --force && if [ -d sdk-assets/go ]; then cp -rf sdk-assets/go/. sdks/go/; fi
scripts.generate:rust: fern generate --group rust-sdk --local --force && if [ -d sdk-assets/rust ]; then cp -rf sdk-assets/rust/. sdks/rust/; fi
